explication_en: patat starts in Main.hs, reads a presentation file via Presentation/Read.hs, which relies on Pandoc, splits the fragments and can evaluate code (Eval.hs). The interactive loop (Interactive.hs) calls Display.hs to draw the slides in the terminal with theme and transitions.
